$description: Opus VO Design System — canonical DTCG token source. The 'figma' namespace preserves all 1,105 $value leaves from the authoritative Figma variable export (7 collections, light/dark semantic modes) verbatim. The 'color', 'typography', 'radius', and 'spacing' top-level groups are the normalised scaffold roles consumed by scripts/build-tokens.mjs to generate src/index.css and src/generated/tokens.tsx. Edit values here only — do not hand-edit generated outputs.

figma.$description: Verbatim Figma variable export. All 7 collections, all modes. Read-only source; do not edit.

light.$description: Light-mode semantic token set. Sourced from Figma '1. Color modes / Light mode'.

dark.$description: Dark-mode semantic token set. Sourced from Figma '1. Color modes / Dark mode'.

sans.$description: Primary UI typeface — Inter variable font, Figma font-family-body.

base.$description: Base corner radius (8px). sm/md/lg/xl derive from this.
Base spacing step (4px). Components multiply this.
